qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sole-source UK naval dockyard operator (Devonport) with long-term Partnering Agreements supporting continuous nuclear submarine maintenance and refits.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). Strategic UK naval dockyard operator, but rejected at Gate 6 due to razor-thin operating margins (4-5%), chronic fixed-price contract disputes/write-downs (>£300M in cumulative losses on Type 31 frigates), and volatile cash conversion.
qualitative.evidence: Devonport dockyard provides critical naval support, but contract execution volatility is chronic: Type 31 frigate program incurred >£300M in cumulative losses and required a formal Dispute Resolution Process with the UK MoD. Statutory operating margins remain compressed at 4-5%.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
